Our Focus

Empowering kids. Connecting communities. Creating digital opportunity.

In a world where technology opens doors, too many children are left behind. We believe no child should be limited by access. Through refurbished laptops, mentorship, and digital resources, we empower children to learn, explore, and imagine the future they deserve.

✓Free device pickup for bulk donations
✓Certified secure data wiping on every device
✓Educational software pre-installed

How It Works

From your closet to a classroom

Every device goes through a rigorous four-step process before it reaches a child.

1

Collect & Secure

We gather donated devices and safely erase all personal data using certified wiping tools.

2

Repair & Refurbish

Each device is inspected, repaired, and upgraded by our technician team.

3

Install & Optimize

Clean OS and educational software installed — classroom-ready out of the box.

4

Deliver & Empower

Devices distributed to children and schools through our partner network.

Home/About Us

Who We Are

A Brooklyn-based nonprofit bridging the digital divide by putting technology in the hands of every child who needs it.

Our Foundation

Purpose-driven from day one

🎯

Mission

Connect underprivileged children to the power of technology by providing refurbished laptops, digital literacy programs, and access to online education — at no cost to families.

🔭

Vision

A society where all children, regardless of their background or circumstances, have access to the technology they need to unlock their full potential and thrive in a digital world.

🏆

Goals

Collect and refurbish used laptops, tablets, and digital tools for children who lack access to technology, while reducing e-waste and building digital literacy across communities.

Our Story

Why we started — and why it still matters

Digital Kids Foundation was founded in Brooklyn, New York with a simple observation: millions of functional laptops sit unused in closets while millions of children sit without the technology they need to succeed in school.

We bridge that gap. Every device we refurbish represents a child who can now do homework, join virtual classes, explore their creativity, and access the same resources available to their more privileged peers.

We believe technology is not a luxury. It is infrastructure for the 21st century, and every child deserves access to it.

🌍

The Digital Divide is Real

1 in 3 low-income students lacks reliable computer access at home. Without it, homework, college prep, and job applications become nearly impossible.

♻️

E-Waste is a Crisis Too

50 million metric tons of electronics are discarded globally each year. Refurbishing extends device life and keeps toxic materials out of landfills.

📈

Education Outcomes Improve

Students with home computers score 17% higher on standardized assessments. Access to a device is one of the highest-impact interventions we can make.

Who We Serve

Every child deserves a fair start

We partner with organizations serving children who face the biggest barriers to technology access.

Schools

We supply devices to under-resourced public schools, prioritizing districts where more than 70% of students qualify for free or reduced-price lunch.

Foster Youth

Children in foster care move frequently and often lose educational continuity. A personal device can be a constant — something that's theirs, wherever they go.

Immigrant Families

Newly arrived families often lack resources to purchase technology. We work with ESL programs and immigration services to reach these families.

Community Centers

After-school programs, youth shelters, and libraries receive devices to extend learning opportunities beyond the school day.

Our Process

How we turn donations into opportunity

1

Collect & Secure

We gather donated devices and erase all personal data using certified wiping tools.

2

Repair & Refurbish

Every device is inspected, repaired, and upgraded to full working order.

3

Install & Optimize

Clean OS and educational software installed — classroom-ready out of the box.

4

Deliver & Empower

Devices distributed to children and schools through our partner network.

Whether you donate a device, give financially, or volunteer your time — you're helping children unlock a brighter future.

Ensuring every child has the technology and support needed to learn and thrive in today's digital world.

Home/FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about donating, volunteering, and how we work.

About the Foundation

Digital Kids Foundation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing underprivileged children with access to laptops, refurbished devices, and digital learning tools. We are based in Brooklyn, New York.
We collect donated laptops and electronic devices, refurbish them through our certified process, and distribute them to children and schools in need. We also support digital literacy programs to help kids learn to use technology effectively, safely, and creatively.
We are based in Brooklyn, New York and work with schools, communities, and partner organizations across the U.S. and internationally to reach children in need.
Digital Kids Foundation is a nonprofit organization based in Brooklyn, New York, dedicated to bridging the digital divide for underserved children. For questions about our organization status, feel free to contact us directly.

Donating a Device

Yes! We accept gently used laptops, tablets, and accessories. Our team ensures they are securely wiped, fully refurbished, and delivered to children who need them most. We accept most brands and conditions — even broken devices may have salvageable parts.
We accept laptops, tablets (including iPads), Chromebooks, keyboards, mice, cables, and chargers. We do not accept desktop computers at this time. If you're unsure whether your device qualifies, use our Contact Us form.
Absolutely. Every device undergoes a certified data-wiping process that meets NIST 800-88 standards. All personal information is permanently and securely erased before any device is refurbished or passed on. A data destruction certificate is available upon request.
Yes! We offer free pickup for donations of 3 or more devices. For single devices, you can drop off at one of our collection points in Brooklyn, or use our mail-in program. Contact us to schedule a pickup or find the nearest drop-off location.

Financial Donations

Absolutely. Financial donations help us cover refurbishment costs, software licenses, replacement parts, training programs, and logistics. Every dollar directly funds our programs.
$25 covers data-wiping software for 5 devices. $50 replaces a laptop battery. $100 fully refurbishes one laptop for a student. $250 equips an entire family with two working devices. 100% of your donation goes directly to our programs.
Yes. Our donate form lets you choose monthly, quarterly, or annual recurring giving. Monthly donors are especially impactful because they give us predictable funding to plan programs and purchase supplies in advance.

Volunteering & Partnerships

Fill out our volunteer application form on the Volunteer page. We have roles for repair technicians, warehouse helpers, community outreach leads, drivers, IT professionals, digital literacy trainers, and content creators. No prior experience is required for most roles.
We welcome collaborations with schools, tech companies, government agencies, and community organizations. Partnerships can include device donations, financial sponsorships, employee volunteer programs, or hosting digital education initiatives. Use our Contact Us form to start a conversation.
We provide regular updates, impact reports, and success stories showing how your contributions are changing children's lives. Transparency is a core value — device donors receive a follow-up report showing where their device was placed.
Email us at help@digitalkidsfoundation.org. We respond to all inquiries within 2 business days. We'd love to hear from you!

Still have questions?

Our team is happy to help with any questions not answered here.
